reference.title: Scenario: reuse in action
reference.shortdesc: A safety warning appears in 23 different procedures across a product documentation set: <note type="warning"

section.p: A safety warning appears in 23 different procedures across a product documentation set:<note type="warning" id="warn_electrical_hazard">Disconnect all power sources before servicing internal components. Failure to do so may result in electrical shock or equipment damage.</note>

This warning lives in one file: global/common_warnings.dita. Every procedure that needs this warning references it:<note type="warning" conref="../global/common_warnings.dita#common_warnings/warn_electrical_hazard"/>
When regulatory requirements mandate updated warning language, one edit updates all 23 locations instantly.
